reason: I'd download it the day I saw it and play with the free tier, snap a few whiteboards, build a notes app. By week two I'd be back in Obsidian like every other time. Five apps and 50 actions is more than enough for a week of poking around, so I'd never hit the paywall.
objection: My notes already live in Obsidian and Notion and they cost me next to nothing. Moving years of notes into a new app that might be gone in a year isn't worth it, and I already know I quit these things.
would_change_my_mind: If it imported my whole Obsidian vault or Notion workspace and the whiteboard-to-organized-notes thing was so good I kept reaching for it after the first week, without me having to rebuild everything.
